why: Norwegian sailing and ski house from 1877 — the LIFA base layer, HELLY TECH shells — with nine US stores and four outlets; owned by Kontoor Brands since 2025.

notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): Helly Hansen owns no production; its own Ethical Trade Norway report gives 0% own or joint-venture production and 102 contracted tier-1 factories in 16 countries. No product page names a maker or mill or states a country of origin. What it can show is a dated, placed founding (Moss, 1877) and a dated record of fabric technology, which is tech, not craft. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: no: Helly Hansen's 2022 Ethical Trade Norway (Etisk Handel) report gives own or joint-venture production as 0% and 100% direct contracting with 102 tier-1 factories in 16 countries (China 42, Vietnam 21, Turkey 13 and others); nothing on hellyhansen.com claims an owned factory
craft_evidence.makers: no on product pages (no factory or maker on any PDP sampled); the company says it publishes a tier-1 and tier-2 supplier list on its website (not opened)
craft_evidence.mills: no (no cloth or yarn mill named; only licensed fill and fleece brands: PrimaLoft, Polartec)
craft_evidence.madein: 0% (no country of origin in any of the 430 men's product descriptions, the Magento country_of_manufacture field is null, and none of the 6 rendered PDPs sampled across categories shows one)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 1877, Moss, Norway; sea captain Helly Juell Hansen and his wife Margarethe made linseed-oiled oilskin jackets and trousers; product award at the 1878 Paris World Expo (heritage page)
craft_evidence.process: partial: dated technology history (Fibrepile fleece 1961 with Norwegian Fiber Pile, LIFA 1970, HELLY TECH 1984, H2Flow 2012); no making process (sewing, factory, finishing) described
craft_evidence.reasoning: Helly Hansen owns no production; its own Ethical Trade Norway report gives 0% own or joint-venture production and 102 contracted tier-1 factories in 16 countries. No product page names a maker or mill or states a country of origin. What it can show is a dated, placed founding (Moss, 1877) and a dated record of fabric technology, which is tech, not craft.

ownership.owner: Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB). The acquisition from CTC Triangle B.V. completed on May 31, 2025 for cash consideration of CAD 1.3 billion (about USD 960 million), per the Kontoor 10-Q for the quarter ended June 28, 2025. The Kontoor 8-K exhibit dated June 2, 2025 announces completion. The 10-Q does not name Canadian Tire as the parent of CTC Triangle.
